title: W9 S1 -- Add the sticky Settings section strip
description: Follow section '### S1 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: tests/w9-settings-nav.spec.ts and the appearance and shortcuts specs pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1446. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/S1.md.

review.note: Approved (CLAIMED; Chromium only). SettingsNav.tsx matches S1. Links are built from the direct-child .settings-section h2s of the nearest .project-settings, with ids derived when missing; a MutationObserver on the container's direct children re-reads them; an IntersectionObserver rooted on the Settings scroller sets aria-current='true'; a pointer click scrolls smoothly and a keyboard click (detail 0) or Reduce Motion scrolls instantly. scrollToSettingsSection(heading) keeps the T0 signature and waits up to 2 s (body MutationObserver) when called before Settings mounts, which is what E1 needs. CSS: the selected link uses weight and colour only; the hover/focus colour change is colour only (no weight, no scale, no fill), and the shared emphasis rule applies untouched. top:-40px hard-codes div.project-settings' 'padding: 40px 48px' (research.css:418). That padding is a literal with no token, so I accept it; D1 should note in design-system.md that the strip's top offset must follow that padding. Spec: 4 cases, fail-first 4/4 on the stub. Gaps, not blocking: Reduce Motion is not exercised by its own case, and the Library settings dialog gets no strip (the plan only placed it on Project settings). Known non-S1 failures it reported belong elsewhere: appearance:62 to T255, appearance:417 to T266, and hoverEmphasis.test (c) to T260, all messaged; shortcuts:107 page.goto timeout under load was rerun alone with a pass (my 3x rerun is queued behind the serial lock). I relied on the worker's 4/4 and did not rerun the spec. T271's 'Export settings...' case can now be rerun against this.

log.note: S1: SettingsNav + css + 4-test spec (4/4 pass, failed first on the stub). appearance/shortcuts: 4 failures not from S1 (A1 hover scale, C3 field between Palette and Section colours in appearance:417, shortcuts:107 goto timeout passes alone). See notes/S1.md. All paths uncommitted edits.
